body: Kiko at Mara are testing transferability and integration cost; dagdag ko ang responsibility test. Kapag mas autonomous ang factory systems, hindi nawawala ang human responsibility—lumilipat lang kung saan ito nakatago: training data, safety thresholds, exception design, escalation rules, at management incentives. The ethical danger is not simply 'robots replace humans.' Mas subtle: kapag distributed across model, vendor and integrator ang decision, sino ang psychologically willing to say, 'akin ang responsibility kapag mali ito'?
